output.response_text:
Hello Enterprise Client 22,

Thank you for reaching out and letting us know about the difficulty you’re experiencing after updating your phone number. We understand how frustrating it can be to be locked out of your account, and we’re here to help you regain access as quickly as possible.

To resolve this issue, we’ll need to verify your identity and confirm the new phone number you attempted to register. Please follow the steps below:

1. Provide a recent invoice, the last four digits of the credit card on file, or answers to your pre‑registered security questions for identity verification.
2. Confirm the new phone number you tried to add to your account.
3. Once we have verified your information, we will clear any lockout flag on your account and reset the MFA token to the new phone number.
4. We will then generate a one‑time password‑reset link and send it to your verified email address.
5. Use the link to set a new password, log in, and complete the MFA enrollment with the updated phone number.
6. If you encounter any further login issues, please clear your browser cache or try accessing the portal using an incognito/private‑browsing window.
7. After completing these steps, let us know that you have successfully regained access so we can close the ticket.

If you have any questions or need additional assistance while completing these steps, please don’t hesitate to reply to this email or contact our support line at 1‑800‑555‑1234.

We appreciate your patience and look forward to getting you back into your account promptly.

Best regards,
Customer Support Team
